test_objective: Check that you can query several entities based on scopes
keywords: Query several entities based on scopes

test_cases.name: 019_01_06 QueryWithFullScope
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query several entities based on scopes
test_cases.template: Query several entities based on scopes
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: scopeq set to '/Madrid/Gardens/ParqueNorte' and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to 'https://ngsi-ld-test-suite/context#Building'
}
